name: Identity & Access Management
description: SSO, MFA, least privilege, just-in-time access and access reviews for people and workloads.

capabilities.name: SSO
capabilities.summary: OIDC single sign-on (authorization code + PKCE, ID token signature checked against the IdP JWKS). Configure on the Identity page.

capabilities.name: MFA
capabilities.summary: TOTP (RFC 6238) enrolment, two-step login, admin reset, required per role (default admin).

capabilities.name: SAML and OIDC
capabilities.summary: OIDC is live. SAML 2.0 is not supported; use an OIDC app in your IdP (Entra ID, Okta, Google, Keycloak all offer one).

capabilities.name: SCIM provisioning
capabilities.summary: SCIM 2.0 /scim/v2/Users (list, filter, create, replace, patch, delete=disable) with a bearer token. Never modifies admins.

capabilities.name: RBAC
capabilities.summary: Six portal roles enforced on every API call; temporary role elevation via JIT.

capabilities.name: ABAC
capabilities.summary: Attribute rules: team must own the resource, production changes need an MFA or SSO session. Checked by M02 before changes.

capabilities.name: IAM role management
capabilities.summary: IAM roles from the account data cache with trust analysis (anyone, cross-account, missing external ID, unused 90+ days) and live policy view.

capabilities.name: Just-in-time access
capabilities.summary: Request a higher role for 1-N hours with a reason; another approver or admin approves; no self-approval.

capabilities.name: Privileged access management
capabilities.summary: Admin and operator access only through time-boxed JIT elevation, MFA enforcement, session marked elevated and audited.

capabilities.name: Temporary permissions
capabilities.summary: JIT grants end automatically at expiry; service tokens always expire (1-365 days).

capabilities.name: Access expiration
capabilities.summary: Per-user access end date; the account is disabled and its sessions revoked when it passes.

capabilities.name: Access reviews
capabilities.summary: Review campaigns over all users: keep or revoke each, revocations applied on close.

capabilities.name: Approval workflows
capabilities.summary: Requests, infrastructure changes and JIT elevation need a different approver.

capabilities.name: Automatic revocation
capabilities.summary: Background sweep every 60 s ends expired JIT grants, user access and service tokens; idle sessions sign out.

capabilities.name: Service identities
capabilities.summary: Named service tokens (fdx_...), stored hashed, roles viewer/developer/operator only, expire in 1-365 days, revocable, last-used tracked.

capabilities.name: Workload identity
capabilities.summary: Per EKS cluster: OIDC issuer, Pod Identity associations and IRSA roles, read live.

capabilities.name: Session auditing
capabilities.summary: Every sign-in recorded with method, IP, client, last activity; users and admins can revoke sessions.
